profile.scope: Local API/PCM/WAV transport with identity/Engine/speech doubles; real isolated CPU Docling contention
profile.threshold_basis: Phase 8 local baseline chat p95 about 65ms at concurrency five; generous demo-only margins allow telemetry, voice encoding and CPU contention. These are not production SLOs.
limitations: Short spike is not highest stable capacity
No real Engine/Atlas/voice model throughput is measured
Docling uses existing cached model weights with offline mode
No biological speech or microphone quality measurement
